title: Guard at Achernar Belt while ships of ours gather there; docks at The Experiment
note: Written by Apophis 2026-11-17 12:11 UTC (orders ENT-036, block APOPHIS: guard where our ships gather beyond the border). Mining widens gather-achernar-belt to 10 ships as Schedar Belt and Ironhollow Fading Signal reach their floors (admirals.log ENT-030); two PAYN mining ships stood there at 11:10 UTC and a combat drone of BUSY was met there before (table met). One jump from The Experiment. The guard never fires; it looks once a minute, leaves under 60 percent hull, in a fight, after 60 minutes or when no ship of ours flies the guarded route, and docks. Standing work, one guard.
